prospects.thesis: RTX is the premier diversified defense/aerospace prime with exposure to missiles (Raytheon), engines (Pratt & Whitney), and avionics (Collins), benefiting from elevated munitions replenishment demand and strong commercial aero aftermarket. The combination of bullish options flow, institutional accumulation, and a more measured 1M run (+8.4%) vs peers suggests room to catch up. Record backlog and GTF engine recovery provide multi-year earnings visibility.

HII is the sole builder of U.S. nuclear aircraft carriers and a key Virginia-class submarine producer, a direct beneficiary of the Navy's 355-ship plan and AUKUS submarine commitments. At 0.9x P/S with +19.3% 1M momentum and bullish institutional flow, it offers unique sub-niche exposure unmatched by diversified primes. Multi-decade contracted backlog provides defensive cash flow in a VIX-rising environment.

Leidos is a leading defense IT and digital modernization contractor serving DoD, intelligence community, and civil agencies — a different sub-niche from hardware primes. At 1.0x P/S with +17.2% 1M momentum and bullish institutional sponsorship, it offers high-margin recurring services exposure tied to AI/cyber modernization budgets. Strong FY guidance raises and a growing classified backlog support continued upside.

Northrop is the sole prime on the B-21 Raider stealth bomber and Sentinel ICBM program — the two largest nuclear modernization efforts in the U.S. budget. Space Systems segment adds high-growth exposure to classified satellite constellations. With +16% 1M momentum, bullish institutional flow, and visibility into a 30-year production ramp, NOC is a cornerstone defense holding at a reasonable 1.8x P/S.

UiPath provides theme diversification away from defense into enterprise AI/automation, as the leading RPA platform integrating agentic AI capabilities into existing workflows. Bullish options flow and institutional accumulation plus a modest +5.9% 1M suggest early-stage positioning before potential breakout. Catalyst: expanding AI agent monetization and improving net revenue retention as enterprises operationalize GenAI deployments.
